title: AUTO/Manual research Factory to Model Challenger
purpose: Execute governed model research from Discovery through protected Forward evidence and register a qualified Model Challenger.
entry_condition: Validated dataset/research plan and legal Factory start/resume action.
authority: Deterministic Factory stage functions; production AUTO orchestration delegates to LangGraph.

transitions.action: Freeze research contract and candidate universe
Run purged CPCV with required seed confirmation for DL/hybrid
Replay survivors on pre-frozen tournament evidence
Register qualified winner as Model Challenger
Evidence is immature but not failed

invariants: Protected holdouts are not same-snapshot tuning authority.
Stage seals bind committed identity and prevent silent resume drift.
Factory winner does not automatically become production Champion.
Dynamic capacity cannot exceed min(LEGAL, RESOURCE, SCIENTIFIC).
failure_behavior: Scientific, resource, seal, lineage or policy mismatch fails closed; terminal failures remain auditable.
restart_behavior: Resume uses same Factory identity/checkpoint only when legal; committed stages are not silently reset.
rollback_behavior: Failed or aborted Factory does not mutate production Champion.
